recordings.previousText: Theory runs out here. No more book past this point; calculation from here on.
recordings.text: Our opening book runs out here. Calculation from here on.
recordings.reason: The departure fires where our opening catalogue ends, not where theory, the known opening or preparation ends, and the game may have left the book before a transposition.

recordings.previousText: The earlier setback has been dealt with. With this move, the position is playable again.
recordings.text: The earlier setback is old news. The position is playable again.
recordings.reason: A move never raises its own evaluation; the opponent's moves made the game playable again, so the take no longer credits this move or the learner.

recordings.previousText: The king's own pieces are sitting on its escape squares. The other side now has a back-rank mate to aim for.
recordings.text: The king is penned in behind its own pieces. The other side now has a back-rank mate to aim for.
recordings.reason: A back-rank mate checks along the king's rank, so the square beside the king toward the checker is never blocked by an own piece; the take now says the king is boxed in behind its own pieces.
